articles.title: Trade War Escalates: Canada Strikes Back with Tariffs on U.S. Goods
articles.summary: Canada is hitting back with tariffs on 700+ U.S. products starting Sept 8, targeting $27 billion in imports. This follows U.S. tariffs on Canadian goods. The trade war is already hurting businesses like a Michigan furniture company.

articles.title: Malaysia's Balancing Act: Anwar's Taiwan Remarks Spark Debate
articles.summary: Malaysia's PM Anwar called Taiwan 'part of China,' angering Taiwan but pleasing Beijing. He also hinted at using force for unity. This has raised questions about Malaysia's non-aligned stance and its ties with China.

articles.title: Trade Talks Collapse: Canada and U.S. on the Brink of a Trade War
articles.summary: Canada and the U.S. were close to a trade deal, but talks broke down over cars and steel. Now they're heading toward a trade war that could hurt both economies. Here's what happened.
